dataSource.wsiat: WSIAT Open Data Portal CSV (98,992 decisions, 1987-2026)
dataSource.wsib: WSIB Open Data Portal + Safety Check (2014-2026)

analysisNeeded.registeredClaims: Parse: Registered claims.xlsx from Safety Check
analysisNeeded.allowedClaims: Parse: Allowed claims.xlsx from Safety Check
analysisNeeded.appealRate: Calculate: WSIAT appeals / Denied claims = % who appeal
analysisNeeded.suppressionGap: Calculate: Denied claims - WSIAT appeals = Workers who gave up
analysisNeeded.onsbtFunnel: Cross-reference: WSIB denials → ODSP applications → ONSBT appeals
analysisNeeded.mentalStressSuppression: Compare: Mental Stress Claims.xlsx vs WSIAT PTSD (159 cases)
analysisNeeded.fatalClaimsSuppression: Compare: Fatal claims investigations vs WSIAT fatal appeals

hypothesis: If WSIB denies 200,000 claims/year but WSIAT only receives 5,000 appeals, then 97.5% of denied workers never appeal (195,000 suppressed claims)
